title: Schemas vs Databases
summary: The default operational advice is one database, many schemas unless isolation requirements justify more databases.
learning_objectives: Choose between schemas and databases using backup, connection, ownership, and isolation facts.
Explain why one database with many schemas is the default for related application data.
Identify cases where separate databases are worth the overhead.
reflection_prompts: Which permission would you remove first if this role were leaked?
What SQL evidence would you attach to an access review?
